note: What the v2 page shows about each app. Facts that only a run can give (attestation, what was tested) are recorded here by hand from v2/ARCHITECTURE.md; everything else is read from the spec by build.mjs.

apps.title: Guest list
apps.origin: Written by an independent model from one sentence and v2/loop/RULES.txt.
apps.sentence: A guest list. The person types a name of at most 40 bytes and presses Add, and the name joins a table with one column, newest first, keeping at most 16. A Clear button empties the list. An empty name is ignored.

limits.emptyIgnored: The theorem proves the revision does not move. That the whole state is unchanged is tested on samples, not proved.
limits.longIgnored: The theorem proves the revision does not move. That the whole state is unchanged is tested on samples, not proved.
limits.staleIgnored: The theorem proves the revision does not move. That the whole state is unchanged is tested on samples, not proved.

unproved: The list never holds more than 16 names.
A new name comes first and the others keep their order.
A name is added exactly as typed.

apps.title: Payment approval
apps.origin: Written by hand on PrismPM's view protocol. The decision is PrismPM's own Payment Approval example, called, not rewritten.

sentences.viewKeepsRevision: Every screen carries the revision of the state it shows.
sentences.clearAdvances: Clearing always moves the revision forward by one.

unproved: The table never holds more than 16 decisions.
A press from an out-of-date screen changes nothing.
